# IP Quality Score & Fraud Threat Detector
> Real-Time IP Reputation, Commercial VPN / Proxy Detection, and ASN Intelligence Lookup

## Project Overview
IP Quality Score Check is a free, high-speed, 100% client-side security tool developed to inspect any IPv4 or IPv6 address for fraud risk, commercial VPN/proxy tunnels, Tor exit nodes, and Autonomous System (ASN) intelligence with zero telemetry storage.

## Canonical URL
https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/ipqualityscore/

## Core Features
- Automatic real-time public IP detection with custom IPv4/IPv6 address lookup.
- 0 to 100 Fraud Risk Scoring: Distinguishes residential traffic from datacenter hosting and malicious exit nodes.
- High-accuracy Proxy, VPN, and Tor exit node threat assessment.
- Detailed Geolocation & ASN intelligence: ISP name, Autonomous System Number, city, country, and coordinates.
- Copyable structured threat report for anti-fraud teams and webmasters.
- 100% Client-Side Privacy: Queries executed directly in-browser with zero backend logging.

## Target Audience
Cybersecurity analysts, e-commerce webmasters, fraud prevention teams, developers debugging geo-blocking, and privacy-conscious internet users.
